insights.one_liner: TriGlobal is a small Dordrecht company running moving-comparison websites like Sirelo, with an international team and IND sponsor status.

culture.text: It runs consumer websites, including Sirelo, that connect people planning a move with moving companies in over 100 countries.
It describes a small, international team with lots of autonomy, ownership and room to take initiative.

open.text: Triglobal B.V. is an IND recognised sponsor.
